contracts.opaque_context: Forwarded to resolver+4 and create+8. Both concrete material registry callbacks ignore it.
contracts.generic_flags: allow_load is consulted only after request/canonical misses; false returns null without insertion. Cache hits always retain, irrespective of retain_on_new_load. New loads retain for caller only if retain_on_new_load is nonzero.
contracts.identity: Length plus CRT stricmp across normalized request aliases; normalization00bee690 lowercases ASCII, converts backslashes and trims ASCII spaces, without lexical dot/slash collapsing. Canonical lookup uses only first alias after resolver returns a name different from request.
contracts.key_resolution: 00b2e940 resolves all-substring .mshd-to-.shfx rewrite first. On failure resolves original and returns its mutated value regardless of second result; third stack opaque argument ignored.
contracts.new_entry: 2Ch stride: canonical native string+0, alias list+8 (sentinel+Ch), five opaque VFS metadata DWORDs+14h, effect+28h. Aliases begin canonical then request if different. Append copies storage and raw effect pointer; no retain in entry copy or release in entry storage destructor.
contracts.reference_transfer: Create callback result is adopted by entry. Renderer adds one caller ref through registry+Ch. Hit path adds caller ref. Aliases do not add owner refs; separate entries may share a fallback effect and each own one ref.
contracts.refcount_abi: 00b31ff0 InterlockedIncrement(effect+4);00b32010 InterlockedDecrement(effect+4), virtual+0 no-stack call at zero. This is intrusive game refcount, not an ID3D COM vtable layout.
contracts.accounting: Generic cache calls effect virtual+Ch on insertion and recomputes before removal; DWORD addition/subtraction. Actual material vtable00d61a00+Ch points00a82250, a 3-byte XOR EAX,EAX;RET leaf, so concrete material effects account zero.
contracts.failure: 00b2ebb0 resolves rewritten shader, allocates178h and invokes load variants/name setter. It does not inspect variant-loader EAX; fallback is not tied to compiler success. Missing VFS resource reaches debug output then recursively renderer+48(error.shfx). No in-progress insertion, self-fallback or depth guard; missing error.shfx can recurse indefinitely.
contracts.null_failure: Generic00b31090 inserts null create results; teardown00b31750 dereferences each effect unconditionally. The host fragment explicitly rejects null before insertion and does not claim equivalence on this native-invalid state.
contracts.teardown: Reverse records; subtract effect size, registry+10 release, destroy alias/name storage, decrement count, vector clear. Registry destructor installs base00d5f04c whose retain/release slots match concrete registry, then clears and frees vector storage.
contracts.font_context: 00ab8ce0 adopts renderer return into+1ECh without another increment; existing nonnull skips selection.00ab8c30 changed font name decrements and clears+1ECh. The cache reference keeps effect alive after text-context invalidation.
contracts.implementation: EffectCache fixes actual renderer0/1/1 path with shared_ptr owner projection, actual mutable VFS resolver callback, external actual-effect loader, size callback and reverse clear. Caller token survives cache clear; no deduplication by object identity and no pending sentinel.
contracts.host_limits: NUL-free ASCII<=INT32_MAX keys; complete callbacks required; null result rejected. std::shared_ptr lifetime abstraction is new and not native ABI. Serialized access. Size callback cannot throw or reenter. Allocation exceptions propagate.
remaining_external: platform pump00beccd0 at every native acquire
VFS metadata query00bdd340 and native vector allocator/exception guarantees
renderer/scene lifetime and resource reload/eviction beyond clear
